description: This file defines the 'Order' controller class within the Opencart admin module, providing functionalities for managing sales orders including listing, viewing, editing, deleting, invoicing, and related actions in the Opencart ecommerce platform.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for handling sale order operations in the Opencart admin interface, including order management, viewing, editing, deletion, and other order-related functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes and displays the list of orders, handling filters and navigation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a simple list view of orders, delegating to getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the order list HTML view, applying filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific order, including customer details, products, totals, and order history.

methods.name: call
methods.description: API method to invoke the storefront API for operations related to orders, such as creating or retrieving order data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected orders after permission validation.

methods.name: invoice
methods.description: Generates an invoice view for selected orders.

methods.name: shipping
methods.description: Displays shipping information and options for selected orders.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Returns the order history HTML, including status updates and comments.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the order history data and renders the history view.

methods.name: createInvoiceNo
methods.description: Generates a new invoice number for an order if permitted.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points to the customer associated with the order.

methods.name: removeReward
methods.description: Removes reward points from the customer linked to the order.

methods.name: addCommission
methods.description: Adds a commission transaction to the affiliate related to the order.

methods.name: removeCommission
methods.description: Removes commission transactions from the affiliate for the order.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete data for orders, typically for search fields.
